item.text: I’m now narrowing to the physical-safety record inside Nigeria: protests, policing, massacre response, accountability, and the state’s handling of abuse complaints. I’ll use the strongest human-rights monitors and official responses, then separate inherited problems from anything Tinubu actually ordered or corrected in 2023.
